# dsh-d365-kit (D365 Toolkit)
**English** | 简体中文
A **development and deployment assistant** for Dynamics 365 CE / Dataverse, installed as a DeepSeek

Harness bundle.
It turns a real D365 organization into something an agent can query directly: metada
ta, solution layers, snapshot diffs, references, migration risk, the impact of code changes, and con
yers, snapshot diffs, references, migration risk, the impact of code changes, and controlled writes.
> Fifteen tools, one settings page. Read-only by default: grant no capabilities and it can only look
ls, one settings page. Read-only by default: grant no capabilities and it can only look, not change.

## What problem it solves
Most day-to-day friction in D365 projects is not "can't write code", it is **information asymmetry b
etween environments**:
| Problem | How this plugin answers |
| If I ship this solution to SIT, will it override another solution's customizations? | `d365_migrat
e` checks layers component by component, listing the solutions that will be shadowed, the components

that are missing, and the option values that will be lost |
| Why is the same form different in two
environments? | `d365_layers` tells you who overrode it, `d365_diff` gives you the field-level diff

erences |
| Will deleting this field break something? | `d365_refs` reverse-looks-up forms / views /

processes / plugin steps, `d365_data` shows how many records still use it |
| Will this MR run once
deployed to UAT? | `d365_code_check` maps JS to web resources and forms, and C# to assemblies/types

/steps/images |
| Upstream changed a plugin — has downstream caught up? | `d365_contract` treats ups
tream registrations as a contract and compares them item by item downstream, with waivers and trends

|
| Can we deploy right now? | `d365_health` shows suspended imports/publishes and failed jobs; the

pre-flight check before writes uses the same data |
| Need to add a field / option value / view col
umn? | `d365_write` produces a plan → a human confirms in the conversation → only then does it write
, with a queryable audit trail afterwards |
## Feature overview
### Connectivity and environments
| Tool | Purpose |
| `d365_envs` | Environment inventory, whether credentials are complete; with `check: true` it actua

lly connects once |
| `d365_configure` | Add, edit or remove environments (URL, tenant, ClientId, se

cret), test connectivity |
| `d365_health` | Suspended/failed background jobs, in-progress import pu
blishes, recently installed solutions |
### Metadata and solution layers
| Tool | Purpose |
| `d365_metadata` | 19 resource kinds: entities, attributes, relationships, forms, views, workflows,
business rules, plugins, web resources, solutions, components, Custom APIs, sitemaps, option sets |
| `d365_layers` | `msdyn_componentlayer`: which solutions have overridden a component, who is on to
p, and which layer is currently active |
### Snapshots and diff
| Tool | Purpose |
| `d365_sync` | Pulls an environment's metadata into a local snapshot, recording "complete / truncat

ed / failed" per resource |
| `d365_diff` | Field-level differences between two snapshots (added, re
moved, modified), with noise filtering and a stale-snapshot warning |
### Impact and data
| Tool | Purpose |
| `d365_refs` | Reverse lookup: field → forms/views/processes; web resource → forms and events; asse

mbly → types and steps |
| `d365_data` | Business records: count / group by / sample (requires `data

.read`) |
| `d365_data_write` | Create or update one business record, executed after confirmation in
the conversation (requires `data.write`) |
### Writes
| Tool | Purpose |
| `d365_write` | Add/update/delete option values, add/update/delete fields, rename a table, add or r
emove system view columns; `plan-*` only produces a plan, `execute` requires manual confirmation |
### Migration and checks
| Tool | Purpose |
| `d365_migrate` | Solution migration risk assessment: layer shadowing, missing components, lost opt

ion values, version and managed state |
| `d365_contract` | Contract matrix and drift: assemblies, p

lugin types, steps, form libraries, handlers, sitemaps, option values; with waivers and trends |
| `
d365_code_check` | Reads a GitLab MR, maps JS/C# changes onto the target environment and reports blo
cker / warning / manual confirmation |
### Operations
| Tool | Purpose |
| `d365_reports` | Local artifacts and disk usage, cleanup per retention policy (dry run by default)
, snapshot compaction |
## Settings page
"Settings → D365 Toolkit" in the DSH Web UI, six tabs:
| Tab | Contents |

| Environments | Environment inventory, test connection, default environment |
| Permissions | Tick
capabilities per environment (read business data / write kinds), default solution for changes, copy

to other environments |
| Plans | Pending write plans, recent change records and publish results (re

-publishable) |
| Data | File count / size / retention policy per artifact kind, dry run and cleanup

, snapshot compaction |

## Known limitations

- Does not collect Ribbon or Power Automate cloud flows.
- `attributes` is requested per entity, so

with many entities the request count equals the entity count; use `entities` to narrow the scope.
-
Metadata tables mostly have no incremental cursor, so every sync is a full pull; a delta is only pos

sible by "running it a second time, then diffing".
- `d365_layers` relies on the `msdyn_componentlay
er` virtual table: you must supply both the component id and the type; a name alone returns 0 rows.
- Component types 36 / 50 / 70 (report and chart kinds) have no matching name in the layer table, so

only their existence is checked.
- Layer order is determined by **import time**, not version number

: whoever imported later is on top.
- `secureconfiguration` always reads back empty through the Web

API, so plugin secure config can only be confirmed manually.
- Contract drift reads live data (not s
napshots) and takes tens of seconds to a few minutes on a large environment.
